CustomField.description: Production Calculated Overage Rate to allow for multiple services
CustomField.formula: IF( ISPICKVAL(TSGCFG__Consolidation_Method__c, 'Average') && TSGCFG__ProdTotalCPCLineItem__c > 0 , TSGCFG__ProdSumofCPCOverageBW__c / TSGCFG__ProdTotalCPCLineItem__c, IF( TSGCFG__ProdTotalMonoVolume__c <> 0, TSGCFG__ProdTotalBWOveragePrice__c / TSGCFG__ProdTotalMonoVolume__c, If(TSGCFG__ProdTotalCPCLineItem__c > 0, TSGCFG__ProdSumofCPCOverageBW__c / TSGCFG__ProdTotalCPCLineItem__c, 0)))
CustomField.label: Prod B&W Overage Rate
